scenes.visual_direction: One-on-one intimacy: two people across a wooden table in honest conversation, coffee between them, morning light — leadership as dialogue. Tight two-shot. [image-beat]
The founder's road: a man walking his farmland alone at golden hour, weathered and thoughtful, the land that taught him stretching around. Wide contemplative. [image-beat]
Autonomy in action: a team member assesses a situation and acts on the spot — no phone call upward, no hesitation, just judgment. Medium, decisive energy.

scenes.visual_direction: Sanctioned generosity: a server carries an unasked-for bottle of wine and dessert to a table, easy confidence in the gesture. Medium warm.
Psychological safety: a young team member raises an issue openly, the listener calm and unbothered — zero drama, problem shrinking as it's spoken. Medium two-shot.
Craft pride: extreme detail of meticulous work — a knife sharpened, a hem pressed, a hinge oiled, a table set exactly — excellence as respect made visible. Macro series. [image-beat]
Mentorship on the job: an experienced hand guiding a newer one — in the kitchen, the garden, at the desk — knowledge passing between generations. Medium warm. [image-beat]
The team's own table: staff sharing a relaxed meal together outdoors after service, laughter, plates passed, guard fully down. Wide golden evening. [image-beat]
The full sweep: a majestic golden-hour aerial across the whole estate — houses in the trees, farm rows, walkways — everything the dream became. Grand wide.
Closing unity: the team gathered outdoors for a morning briefing in soft first light, nods, smiles, then everyone moves off to work with purpose. Wide to medium, rousing.
